sources.observation: Pale brick and brownstone frame the open carriage entrance on West 72nd Street. Steep charcoal slate gables and green domed oriels rise above the iron balcony.

limitations: Fine ironwork, carved stone and the shapes of some secondary roofs interpret the available photo. The model includes the exterior, the courtyard and covered approach.
